service.description: Internal: whether the current user sees full lesson content. Staff of the owning company always do; others only for courses without a product (free) or whose product they hold an active subscription for.

Internal: per module of a course, for one learner: done (all lessons completed and the quiz, if any, passed), locked (sequential unlock and an earlier module not done), dueDate and overdue (dueDays after the cohort start, or after the learner started).

actions.script: def slurper = new groovy.json.JsonSlurper() List completed = progressEntity?.completedLessons ? slurper.parseText(progressEntity.completedLessons as String) as List : [] Map scores = progressEntity?.quizScores ? slurper.parseText(progressEntity.quizScores as String) as Map : [:] def quizModules = questionList*.moduleId.unique() java.sql.Timestamp now = ec.user.nowTimestamp java.sql.Timestamp start = courseEntity.pacing == 'COHORT' && courseEntity.cohortStartDate ? courseEntity.cohortStartDate : (progressEntity?.startedDate ?: now) boolean sequential = courseEntity.sequentialUnlock == 'Y' moduleStates = [:] overdueCount = 0 dueSoonCount = 0 boolean earlierOpen = false for (module in moduleList) { def lessonIds = lessonList.findAll { it.moduleId == module.moduleId }*.lessonId boolean done = lessonIds.every { it in completed } && (!(module.moduleId in quizModules) || ((scores[module.moduleId] ?: 0) as int) >= 70) java.sql.Timestamp dueDate = module.dueDays ? new java.sql.Timestamp(start.time + (module.dueDays as long) * 24L * 3600L * 1000L) : null boolean overdue = dueDate != null && !done && now.after(dueDate) if (overdue) overdueCount++ else if (dueDate != null && !done && dueDate.time - now.time < 2L * 24L * 3600L * 1000L) dueSoonCount++ moduleStates[module.moduleId] = [done: done, locked: sequential && earlierOpen, dueDate: dueDate, overdue: overdue] if (!done) earlierOpen = true }

service.description: Daily batch (cron): remind learners of an unfinished course when a module is due within 2 days or overdue, or they have not been in the course for 7 days. At most one reminder per learner and course every 3 days; sent through the company's own SMTP settings only. With dryRun nothing is sent: the reminders are returned.

set.from: reason == 'OVERDUE' ? 'Some modules are past their due date. It is not too late: pick up where you left off.' : (reason == 'DUE_SOON' ? 'A module is due within two days.' : 'You have not been in the course for a while. A few minutes today keeps you going.')

iterate.script: def firstName = person?.firstName ?: '' def lastName = person?.lastName ?: '' def fullName = (firstName + ' ' + lastName).trim() def username = userAccount?.username ?: '' def courseTitle = course.title ?: '' // Apply search filter on name, email/username or course title def matchesFilter = true if (filter?.trim()) { def q = filter.trim().toLowerCase() matchesFilter = fullName.toLowerCase().contains(q) || username.toLowerCase().contains(q) || courseTitle.toLowerCase().contains(q) } if (matchesFilter) { participants.add([ courseId: course.courseId, courseTitle: courseTitle, userId: userAccount?.userId, partyId: subscription.subscriberPartyId, firstName: firstName, lastName: lastName, username: username, progressPercent: prog?.progressPercent ?: 0, completedLessons: prog?.completedLessons, startedDate: prog?.startedDate, lastAccessDate: prog?.lastAccessDate, completedDate: prog?.completedDate ]) }
